{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI
# Controls when the action will run.
# Github Actions multiple gemfile support?
on:
  # Triggers the workflow on push or pull request events but only for the master branch
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # need to figure out how to use redis on macos github actions
        # os: [ubuntu-24.04, macos-15]
        os: [ubuntu-24.04]
        # remove until I sort out CI issues for truffle
        # truffleruby,
        # truffleruby-head,
        # removing jruby again to flaky
        gemfile: [ Gemfile.rails7.0, Gemfile.rails7.1, Gemfile.rails7.2, Gemfile.rails8.0 ]
        # need to add support for multiple gemfiles
        ruby: ["3.1", "3.2", "3.3", "3.4", "4.0", "ruby-head"]
        exclude:
          # Rails 8 requires ruby 3.2+.
          - gemfile: 'Gemfile.rails8.0'
            ruby: '3.1'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: ${{ matrix.gemfile }}
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      memcached:
        image: memcached:1.6
        ports:
          - 11211:11211
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "timeout 2 bash -c '</dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/11211'"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
          # PR merge refs cannot share their newly created caches with main. Since
          # this matrix is large, only main is allowed to persist Bundler caches.
          bundler-cache: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
      - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.gemfile }}-${{ hashFiles(matrix.gemfile) }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.gemfile }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
      - name: Install dependencies without a persistent cache
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - run: bundle exec rake test:all
        env:
          # the memcached adapter has an ENV gate so local runs need no service,
          # which also meant CI never exercised it
          COVERBAND_MEMCACHED: "true"
      - run: "RUBYOPT='--enable=frozen-string-literal --debug=frozen-string-literal' bundle exec rake"
        env:
          COVERBAND_MEMCACHED: "true"
      # Solid Cache needs Rails 7.2+, and its engine changes process wide state,
      # so it runs on its own, only where it is available.
      #
      # Its gems sit in an optional bundler group, which bundler-cache does not
      # install, so the group is installed here rather than assumed present.
      - name: Solid Cache adapter tests
        if: matrix.gemfile == 'Gemfile.rails8.0'
        run: |
          bundle config set --local with solid_cache
          bundle install --jobs 4
          bundle exec rake test:solid_cache
  starndardrb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.1
          bundler-cache: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
      - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.1-Gemfile-${{ hashFiles('Gemfile') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.1-Gemfile-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.1-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
      - name: Install dependencies without a persistent cache
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - run: bundle exec standardrb --format github
  javascript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - run: node --test test/javascript/*.test.mjs
  json3:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: Gemfile
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      memcached:
        image: memcached:1.6
        ports:
          - 11211:11211
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: "3.4"
          bundler-cache: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
      - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.4-Gemfile-${{ hashFiles('Gemfile') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.4-Gemfile-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.4-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
      - name: Install dependencies without a persistent cache
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Verify JSON 3 resolution
        run: bundle exec ruby -rjson -e 'abort "expected JSON 3" unless JSON::VERSION.start_with?("3.")'
      - run: bundle exec rake test:all
        env:
          COVERBAND_MEMCACHED: "true"
  redis_compatibility:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        redis-version: [4, 5, 6, 7]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:${{ matrix.redis-version }}
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: "3.4"
      - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: vendor/bundle
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.4-Gemfile-${{ hashFiles('Gemfile') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.4-Gemfile-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-3.4-
            ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
      - name: Install dependencies without a persistent cache
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - run: bundle exec rake test:all",
  "rationale": "Add actions/cache@v4 for Bundler dependencies (vendor/bundle) to the Ruby jobs that run bundle install without a persistent cache on pull requests (test, starndardrb, json3) and to redis_compatibility, which has no bundler-cache at all. The cache key includes runner OS, Ruby version, gemfile, and the gemfile hash, with restore keys for partial matches. This preserves all test steps, services, and matrix coverage while reducing repeated dependency fetching on PR runs. Supported by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency cache pattern) and the measured Ruby CI experiment showing elapsed-time savings from adding a Bundler actions/cache step.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2"]
}
